title: Canadian Dollar weakens amid falling oil prices, stronger US Dollar
summary: USD/CAD extends its gains for the fifth consecutive day, trading around 1.4140 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) faces downward pressure from falling crude oil prices.

title: British Pound consolidates above 1.3200, its lowest since late June against a bullish USD
summary: The GBP/USD pair edges higher during the Asian session on Friday, trading above its lowest level since June 29, around the 1.3200 neighborhood, touched the previous day.

title: UK food and drink trade deficit largest since 2000 at £21bn
summary: Industry leaders call on government to protect homegrown produce in the interest of national security The gap between Britain’s food and drink exports and imports has neared its highest this century, as a combination of Brexit, war in the Middle East and US tariffs dented deliveries overseas while imports soared. The UK’s food and drink trade deficit has risen to more than £21bn – the largest since 2000 – in what industry leaders said was a “wake-up call” for the government to protect homegrown produce in the interest of national security.
